purpose: Small editable ledger for printer/media/transfer/etch specimens. It is not a queue, route, inventory authority, or recipe database.
safety_laws: Unknown coated, waxed, siliconised, vinyl, acetate, or inkjet-only stock does not enter the laser. Use media explicitly rated for the exact printer or a known laser-safe transfer carrier.
Electro-etch chemistry is selected by substrate metal; voltage alone is not a process specification.
Chloride electrolyte is not the default experimental electrolyte.

Do not develop the first electro-etch process on stainless steel. Anodic/transpassive dissolution can release chromium species including Cr(VI); define capture, waste, and exposure controls before any stainless trial.
All spent electro-etch electrolyte is treated as metal-bearing waste; do not pour it to drain.
Stop a wet/electrical test on unexpected heating, vigorous gas evolution, odour, unusual colour change, exposed wiring, resist delamination, or unstable current.
No chemistry, heated transfer, cutting, or powered etch work when fatigued or nodding off.

electrochem_measurement.research_window_note: Published electrochemical etching/machining literature spans roughly single-digit to hundreds of mA/cm2 depending on metal/electrolyte/flow. Treat 1-100 mA/cm2 as an instrumentation/logging envelope for small non-stainless coupon research, not as a universal operating recipe. First bounded coupon should start at the low end and rise only on observed need.

first_coupon_guard.goal: Find minimum charge density giving legible material removal with acceptable edge undercut.

experiments.move: Print media-test-plate-v0.1.svg at 100 percent actual size on ordinary known-good paper on the L18050 and Brother laser.
experiments.stop: If scale is outside 99-101 mm, resolve driver scaling before exotic media.

experiments.move: Print the same diagnostic plate on the Xuan/rice-paper roll across a small ink-load/quality matrix; selectively wet one sacrificial print after initial dry-down.
experiments.stop: Do not tune several axes at once.

experiments.move: Use dedicated or verified laser-safe transfer stock to move the diagnostic feature ladder onto a copper or mild-steel coupon. No etch yet.
experiments.stop: If resist is not continuous, repair transfer mechanics before adding chemistry.

experiments.move: Current-limited DC etch of the P2 non-stainless coupon with a deliberately selected non-chloride electrolyte; log current density and charge density.
experiments.stop: Stop on unexpected heat, vigorous gas, odour, colour change, resist failure, or unstable current.

experiments.move: Laser-print dense black diagnostic marks on known laser-safe smooth stock; apply toner-reactive foil with controlled heat/pressure.
Use the L18050 with inkjet-coated transparency as a calibrated contact-print negative/positive for cyanotype or another selected UV process.
experiments.note: Visual blackness is not sufficient evidence of UV blocking.

experiments.move: Print a reduced-halftone diagnostic image on laser-compatible polyester lithography plate and pull one hand-printed impression.
Transfer one mirrored laser print through acrylic/image-transfer medium onto one rigid scrap substrate rather than feeding the substrate through a printer.
Use existing tiling/imposition software to compile one 1.2-1.8 m composition into registered vertical strips; preserve seams as explicit geometry rather than pretending to have a wide-format printer.

Compose colour, toner, foil, wet-media, or resist layers through separate registered carriers. Do not cross-feed media through another printer unless that media/process is independently rated for the second printer.

must_show: same source identity survives digital-to-physical transformation
settings/materials are sufficient to reproduce a useful result
one reusable transform or diagnostic actually reduces the next experiment cost
